name: focus_remote_teleport_offset
about: A remote player (box 1.8 high in both versions) gets an S18 to its own position. 1.7.10 adds 0.015625 to the S18 y, so after the 3-tick interpolation its pick box top (with the 0.1 border) is 65.915625; 1.8.9 keeps the position (within the 1/64 snap rule), top 65.9. The look ray meets the box's front face (x = 10.38125) at y ~ 65.905: 1.7.10 attacks (C02), 1.8.9 misses (swing only, MISS cooldown).
